item.title: RimWorld Room Impressiveness Calculator — Score & Level (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Use the RimWorld room impressiveness calculator to find your room's score and level. Enter room wealth, beauty, space and cleanliness to instantly see the resulting level and colonist mood — built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version.
